title: Training and development
log: 2026-10-29T12:22:32Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No point in the bank covers training and development; the closest, managing change well, only mentions training as one way to support change, so this needs a new point.

draft.title: Training and development
card: teaching staff the skills they need for their current job. It aims to lift how well they do that job now.
training done at the workplace while staff do real work, such as learning beside an experienced worker. It is usually cheaper and does not take people away from work.
training done away from the normal work area, such as a course run by an outside provider. It can bring in new methods, but it costs money and time away from work.
building a person's skills and knowledge for roles they may hold in the future, such as a leadership program for a promising employee.
draft.remember: Training builds skills for the job now. Development prepares staff for later roles.

a.q: Which example is staff development rather than training?
opts: A sales assistant joins a program to prepare for management
A new cashier learns the till by working beside a colleague
A chef attends a course on a new kitchen safety method
A driver is shown how to use a new delivery app
a.why: Development prepares a person for a future role, and a management program does that for a sales assistant. The other three teach skills for the job the person does now, so they are training.
a.clue: Which one looks ahead to a different role?

b.q: Priya manages a small bakery in Orange. She wants a new baker to learn the ovens quickly without losing production time or paying course fees. Which approach best suits this aim?
opts: On-the-job training beside an experienced baker
Off-the-job training at an outside baking course
Off-the-job training at a supplier's training centre
A development program for future bakery managers
b.why: On-the-job training happens at the bakery during real work, so it avoids course fees and time away. Off-the-job training is tempting for its new methods, but it costs money and takes the baker away from work.
b.clue: Which type happens while real work goes on?

a.best: A sales assistant joins a program to prepare for management

b.best: On-the-job training beside an experienced baker
